interpretation.what_200_blind_tasks_means: The preregistered Part-A independent-validation sample (docs/architecture/label-and-heldout-validation-protocol.md): 200 development records drawn deterministically across strata (seed 20260817), each with up to 6 source-anchored passages, materialized as a blind annotation file plus a sealed weak-label key.
interpretation.benchmark_materials_correction: The task brief described the task set as 'sampled from benchmark materials, compared against published_expert_reference'. In this repo, validation-output/benchmark-materials/ holds the VAL-3 published-review reconstruction materials (5 review families: ag-rdt-living-update, bmj-covid-therapies-methods, carbon-pricing-screening, hepsanet-controlled-ipd, sci-exercise-analysis) and contains only operational_input + documentation + fetch receipts; its sealed published answers (published_expert_reference) are NOT present locally or on the server and VAL-3 is explicitly unfrozen. The 200 blind tasks therefore come from the training-corpus development split, and the reference is the deterministic weak-label key (weak_label_status: deterministic_weak_candidate), NOT published_expert_reference.
interpretation.reference_nature: Deterministic source-anchored weak labels (not human gold, not truth). All R2 numbers are agreement with frozen weak labels.
interpretation.sealing: The weak-label key is never read on the server during prediction; scoring runs locally only after every provider call is locked.
